status.description: proposed: part of the plan (the default). suggested: proposed by the agent, not yet accepted. dismissed: a suggestion the person turned down, kept so it isn't suggested again.

at.description: Where it sits on the map

journey.description: The journey it becomes: a new ID, or an existing journey whose steps it replaces

actor.description: Whose goal it serves. Required for a new journey.

goal.description: What they're doing. Required for a new journey.

code.description: Code entry point for this step

sends.description: Data entries this step sends, such as RefundRequest

returns.description: Data entries the callee answers with, such as RefundDecision: the step is a request and its response

creates.description: Records this step creates, such as Refund or { Refund: { status: pending } }

changes.description: Fields this step changes, such as Charge.status: captured -> refunded

source.description: declared: written by a person (the default). inferred: produced by an analyzer. suggested: proposed by an AI agent and not yet accepted.

provenance.description: Where a fact came from. Absent means declared by a person.
